messages:
nate: Quick broadcast: initiating a 90m soft freeze on the release train — observed p95 spikes on canary shard C, want to stop new rollout jobs and throttle traffic while we diagnose.
sophia: soft only? any immediate rollback?
nate: soft. No merges into main->prod until we lift. Emergency hotpatches ok with explicit release-ops signoff.
rachel: can you publish the throttle spec? i need to tune the autoscaler for session-workers.
nate: Spec posted: 1) canary traffic -> 15% (gradual siphon to warm pool D), 2) token-bucket limit on /v1/generate (burst 200, refill 50/s), 3) increase autoscaler min_replicas=4 for session-worker for the window.
runtime-bot: Canary manager: deployment v3.10.1 paused on shard C. Auto-rollback armed: error_rate > 2% sustained for 3m triggers rollback.
infra-oncall: monitoring queue depth and pod restart rate. If queue depth >1500, we'll shift canary to shard B.
sophia: telemetry note: KVCache eviction spikes correlate to short-seq latency bursts; sample logs below —
```
[2026-03-22T09:14:02Z] node-12 KVCacheEvict key=ctx-0 size=128
[2026-03-22T09:14:03Z] node-12 KVCacheEvict key=ctx-1 size=256
```
rachel: copying in trace id for a bad request: trace=trace-7a9f3c — p95 on that trace was 4.1s. collecting heap + thread dump.
nate: nice. if heap leak looks likely, request eng-runtime for a hotpatch; otherwise we'll move canary traffic off C.
sophia: i've kicked a targeted canary with KV-prefetch=false and smaller batch_size=8. will report p50/p95 in 10m.
release-bot: Deploy bot: all scheduled rollouts are blocked while quiet-window active. Release-ops can override with /release-override.
infra-oncall: sending link for exception form: https://internal/release-ops/exceptions 34 include rollback steps and impact matrix.
nate: operational summary: soft-freeze 90m, canary -> 15% + token-bucket, autoscaler min_replicas bumped, hotpatches via approval only. i'll post updates when we decide lift/extend. :white_check_mark:
sophia: noted. posting heap dumps to the incident ticket.
release-bot: Incident-tracker: ticket #IR-2026-143 opened and linked to shard C canary events.
